---
title: "CGT: Capital Gains Tax"
description: "Information about capital gains tax paid by persons or sole traders on profits from disposing of assets such as property, shares and crypto assets."
---

Information about capital gains tax paid by persons or sole traders on profits from disposing of assets such as property, shares and crypto assets.

*Explains CGT events, capital gains and losses, affected assets and tax-return reporting.*

The discount is applied several steps later, after capital losses, so the figure here is a gross gain. A zero for a company is a feature of the tax law rather than evidence that the company sold no long-held shares.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 1 more"]},{"n":"ACTV_SHARES_UNITS_INDX_M","d":"Gains on shares or trust units used in the taxpayer's business, worked out by indexing the cost base rather than discounting the gain.","full":"Gains on shares or trust units used in the taxpayer's business, worked out by indexing the cost base rather than discounting the gain. Indexation is only open to old holdings: the ATO restricts the method to \"capital gains made on CGT assets acquired before 11:45 am AEST on 21 September 1999\". The active label is a claim about eligibility rather than about the asset, because a gain belongs on the active side only where the entity is going on to claim the small business 50% active asset reduction, the retirement exemption or the roll-over.","dsrc":"ATO, Instructions to complete the CGT schedule and tax return 2025, step 1 and step 2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/capital-gains-tax-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-cgt-schedule-and-tax-return-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Active assets - Shares and units (in unit trusts): Capital gains - indexation method","k":"Capital gains on active shares and units, indexation method (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount before any capital losses, the CGT discount or the small business concessions are applied, being one of three method cells on the shares and units row of the schedule used up to 2012-13.","p":"2000-2001 to 2012-2013","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Instructions to complete the CGT schedule and tax return 2025, step 1 and step 2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/capital-gains-tax-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-cgt-schedule-and-tax-return-2025","lim":"The column thins mechanically as pre-September 1999 holdings are sold down, so a fall over the 2000s is a cohort effect rather than a change in investor behaviour. It is also not ordinary share trading: only gains for which small business concessions are being claimed reach the active side at all.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 1 more"]},{"n":"ACTV_SHARES_UNITS_OTH_O","d":"Gains on business shares or units that qualify for neither indexation nor the discount, usually because they were held under a year.","full":"Gains on business shares or units that qualify for neither indexation nor the discount, usually because they were held under a year. The ATO puts the method last in the order: the other method applies \"if neither the indexation method nor the discount method applies\". Read against the discount cell on the same row, this figure is a rough measure of short-held disposals inside a small business. Nothing is reduced later, so the amount enters the net capital gain calculation at full value.","dsrc":"ATO, Instructions to complete the CGT schedule and tax return 2025, step 1","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/capital-gains-tax-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-cgt-schedule-and-tax-return-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Active assets - Shares and units (in unit trusts): Other capital gains","k":"Capital gains on active shares and units, other method (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount gross of losses and of the small business concessions, carrying no later reduction for the CGT discount, being one of three method cells on the shares and units row.","p":"2000-2001 to 2012-2013","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Instructions to complete the CGT schedule and tax return 2025, step 1","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/capital-gains-tax-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-cgt-schedule-and-tax-return-2025","lim":"It is not purely short-term trading, because a company that cannot use the discount reports its long-held share gains here as well. The row also cannot separate listed shares from unlisted units, a distinction the redesigned schedule later drew.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 1 more"]},{"n":"ASMT_NUM","d":"Which assessment of the entity's return this schedule was captured against, rather than anything about the capital gains themselves.","full":"Which assessment of the entity's return this schedule was captured against, rather than anything about the capital gains themselves. The ATO issues a notice of assessment when a return is processed and can revise it afterwards, since \"this review period is normally 2 years, but in certain circumstances it can be 4 years\", and each revision produces a further assessment. One entity and income year can therefore carry more than one assessment. Reading the field as an administrative version marker is the safe course: the ATO does not publish a definition of it as it appears in this asset.","dsrc":"ATO, Your notice of assessment","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/your-notice-of-assessment","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Assessment number","k":"ATO assessment identifier for the return the schedule was lodged with","def":"An administrative number attached to an assessment of one entity for one income year. It has no economic content and no published code list or format.","p":"2000-2001 to 2011-2012","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Your notice of assessment","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/your-tax-return/your-notice-of-assessment","lim":"It cannot date anything, and it is not a count of amendments unless the numbering is sequential, which is nowhere published. Rows that differ only in this field may be successive assessments of the same return rather than separate lodgments, so counting rows overstates the number of schedules filed.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12"]},{"n":"BN","d":"The entity that lodged the capital gains tax schedule, keyed the way businesses are keyed in BLADE.","full":"The entity that lodged the capital gains tax schedule, keyed the way businesses are keyed in BLADE. The schedule is attached to a company, trust or superannuation fund income tax return, so this identifies an entity rather than a person; the synthetic person key on the same row is what links the record into the person-level asset. Because BLADE combines business activity statements, business income tax filings and payroll reporting, the key is what lets a capital gain be set against the same business's turnover, employment and survival. It appears on every year of the capital gains tables.","dsrc":"ABS, Business Longitudinal Analysis Data Environment (BLADE)","durl":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/integrated-data/business-longitudinal-analysis-data-environment-blade","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Business Number","k":"ABS BLADE business identifier","def":"An opaque business-level identifier, one value per business unit, stable across the yearly capital gains tables and across the other BLADE-linked business collections.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ABS, Business Longitudinal Analysis Data Environment (BLADE)","url":"https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/data-integration/integrated-data/business-longitudinal-analysis-data-environment-blade","lim":"It is not an ABN and cannot be looked up. An entity that restructures may take a new key, so a run of schedules for what an owner would call one business can break in the middle. The key also does not say whether the lodger is a company, a trust or a fund, which the entity type column carries.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CG_CLCBLS_AMT","d":"Capital gains for the year on paintings, jewellery, antiques, coins, rare books and stamps kept for personal enjoyment.","full":"Capital gains for the year on paintings, jewellery, antiques, coins, rare books and stamps kept for personal enjoyment. The ATO's list is closed, and the class only enters the CGT net above a threshold: a gain or loss is disregarded where \"you acquired the collectable for $500 or less\". Losses are ring-fenced, since \"you can only use capital losses from collectables to reduce capital gains (including future capital gains) from collectables\", which is why the schedule gives collectables their own row and a separate carried-forward loss column. This is the collectables figure on the form used up to 2012-13.","dsrc":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax 2021, What is a CGT asset?","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/capital-gains-tax-guide-2021/whats-new/does-capital-gains-tax-apply-to-you/what-is-a-cgt-asset","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains - Collectables","k":"Capital gains from collectables, schedule used to 2012-13 (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount before losses, the CGT discount and the small business concessions, sitting alongside the indexation, discount and other method cells that make up the collectables row of the older schedule.","p":"2000-2001 to 2012-2013","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax 2021, What is a CGT asset?","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/capital-gains-tax-guide-2021/whats-new/does-capital-gains-tax-apply-to-you/what-is-a-cgt-asset","lim":"Because the $500 acquisition threshold removes most items, the column measures the top of the collectables market rather than household ownership of art or jewellery. Collectables can never be active assets, so nothing here can reach the small business concessions.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 1 more"]},{"n":"CG_CLCTBLS_AMT","d":"Capital gains from collectables on the redesigned schedule, where they are one of nine named categories of current year gains.","full":"Capital gains from collectables on the redesigned schedule, where they are one of nine named categories of current year gains. From 2012-13 item 1 of the schedule lists asset types rather than the active and non-active method grid the earlier tables carry, and the ATO tells the taxpayer to organise each worksheet under categories that \"are the same as those set out in item 1 of the CGT schedule\". A collectables gain received through a trust goes in the collectables row and not the trust row, and must be grossed up first. This is the same idea as the differently spelt column on the older tables, under a different form.","dsrc":"ATO, Instructions to complete the CGT schedule and tax return 2025, step 1 and step 4","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/capital-gains-tax-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-cgt-schedule-and-tax-return-2025","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains - Collectables","k":"Capital gains from collectables, redesigned schedule (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount for one entity and income year, gross of losses and of any discount, entered at the collectables label of item 1 and added into total current year capital gains.","p":"2012-2013 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Instructions to complete the CGT schedule and tax return 2025, step 1 and step 4","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/capital-gains-tax-schedule-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-the-cgt-schedule-and-tax-return-2025","lim":"It is not directly comparable with the older tables, which carried the collectables gain a second time split by method across cells this form does not have, so a series spanning 2012-13 is not continuous. A trust distribution entered here has been grossed up by two or four, so the amount can be several times what the trust actually paid out.","where":["pmp-cgt-2012-13 / cgt_2012_13_part2","pmp-cgt-2013-14 / cgt_2013_14","pmp-cgt-2014-15 / cgt_2014_15","pmp-cgt-2015-16 / cgt_2015_16","pmp-cgt-2016-17 / cgt_2016_17","pmp-cgt-2017-18 / cgt_2017_18","pmp-cgt-2018-19 / cgt_2018_19","pmp-cgt-2019-20 / cgt_2019_20","pmp-cgt-2020-21 / cgt_2020_21","pmp-cgt-2021-22 / cgt_2021_22","pmp-cgt-2022-23 / cgt_2022_23"]},{"n":"CG_CY_TOTL_AMT","d":"Every capital gain the entity made in the year, added up before any loss, discount or concession is taken off.","full":"Every capital gain the entity made in the year, added up before any loss, discount or concession is taken off. It is the gross top of the CGT calculation and is several steps away from the taxable figure: the ATO instructs that at this point the lodger does not apply \"capital losses\", \"the CGT discount\" or \"the small business CGT concessions\". On the schedules to 2011-12 the same quantity was split across three method columns and has been brought together here, which is why it is available across the full 2000-01 to 2022-23 span.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label J","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total current year capital gains","k":"Total current year capital gains, CGT schedule item 1 label J (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount summing all asset-type rows for the year. On the 2013 and later form it is the sum of labels A to I; on the earlier form it is the sum of the indexation, discount and other method totals.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label J","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"It is not income and not a tax base. Gains removed by an exemption never enter it, so the small business 15-year exemption amount at item 8 and gains disregarded by a foreign resident sit outside the total, and a year with a large exempt disposal can show a small figure here.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CG_DSRGRDD_DMRGG_ENT_AMT","d":"Capital gains a parent entity did not have to recognise when it spun a subsidiary out to its own owners.","full":"Capital gains a parent entity did not have to recognise when it spun a subsidiary out to its own owners. The ATO puts the condition simply: \"You may be able to disregard any capital gains arising from a demerger if you're a demerging entity in a demerger group.\" It is the demerger exemption claimed by the entity doing the demerging, and the instructions exclude amounts covered by the separate demerger roll-over that the shareholders claim.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label E","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains disregarded by a demerging entity","k":"Capital gains disregarded by a demerging entity, CGT schedule item 8 label E (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gain disregarded by the head of a demerger group, disclosed at item 8 and excluded from the net capital gain at item 6.","p":"2012-2013 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label E","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"Non-zero values are rare and belong to large listed restructures, so the column will not support any analysis of ordinary businesses. It also cannot be added to the roll-over labels beside it without confusing relief taken by the demerging entity with relief taken by its owners.","where":["pmp-cgt-2012-13 / cgt_2012_13_part2","pmp-cgt-2013-14 / cgt_2013_14","pmp-cgt-2014-15 / cgt_2014_15","pmp-cgt-2015-16 / cgt_2015_16","pmp-cgt-2016-17 / cgt_2016_17","pmp-cgt-2017-18 / cgt_2017_18","pmp-cgt-2018-19 / cgt_2018_19","pmp-cgt-2019-20 / cgt_2019_20","pmp-cgt-2020-21 / cgt_2020_21","pmp-cgt-2021-22 / cgt_2021_22","pmp-cgt-2022-23 / cgt_2022_23"]},{"n":"CG_DSRGRDD_FORGN_RSDNT_AMT","d":"Capital gains a foreign resident entity did not have to pay tax on, because the asset was not taxable Australian property.","full":"Capital gains a foreign resident entity did not have to pay tax on, because the asset was not taxable Australian property. The ATO frames the test this way: \"If you're a foreign resident, you're subject to CGT if a CGT event happens to a CGT asset that is 'taxable Australian property'.\" The amount is disclosed for information at item 8 and is not carried into the net capital gain at item 6.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label B","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains disregarded by a foreign resident","k":"Capital gains disregarded under the foreign resident exemption, CGT schedule item 8 label B (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gain removed from the Australian tax base, reported before any CGT discount is applied. It is a disclosure row, not a component of any total on the schedule.","p":"2012-2013 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label B","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"A non-zero value only marks a gain the entity treated as exempt on its own assessment of residency and of whether the asset was taxable Australian property; both are contestable positions rather than settled facts. The row also does not say what the asset was.","where":["pmp-cgt-2012-13 / cgt_2012_13_part2","pmp-cgt-2013-14 / cgt_2013_14","pmp-cgt-2014-15 / cgt_2014_15","pmp-cgt-2015-16 / cgt_2015_16","pmp-cgt-2016-17 / cgt_2016_17","pmp-cgt-2017-18 / cgt_2017_18","pmp-cgt-2018-19 / cgt_2018_19","pmp-cgt-2019-20 / cgt_2019_20","pmp-cgt-2020-21 / cgt_2020_21","pmp-cgt-2021-22 / cgt_2021_22","pmp-cgt-2022-23 / cgt_2022_23"]},{"n":"CG_ERNT_ARNGMNTS_YR_IN_NUM","d":"How far into the earnout deal this year's schedule sits, counted from the start of the arrangement.","full":"How far into the earnout deal this year's schedule sits, counted from the start of the arrangement. The ATO instruction is to \"Write at label C the year of the earnout arrangement you're in\", and its example gives 2 for the second year of a four year deal. Paired with the total term at label B, it lets a reader place a row on the timeline of one contract without needing the sale date.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 7 label C","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"What year of that arrangement are you in?","k":"Year of the earnout arrangement reached, CGT schedule item 7 label C","def":"A small whole number counting elapsed years within one arrangement, starting at 1. It is an ordinal position, not a calendar year.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 7 label C","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"It is not a date and cannot be read as one: 2 means the second year of the deal, not the year 2002. Treating consecutive rows as a clean sequence also fails where an entity has more than one earnout, since only one arrangement is reported on the schedule itself.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CG_ERNT_ARNGMTS_PRTY_CD","d":"Whether the entity was in a deal where part of the price depends on how the business performs after the sale, and if so on which side of it.","full":"Whether the entity was in a deal where part of the price depends on how the business performs after the sale, and if so on which side of it. The schedule offers three boxes at item 7 label A, \"Yes, as a buyer\", \"Yes, as a seller\" and \"No\", so this is a three-way indicator rather than a plain yes or no. It gates the rest of item 7: a buyer completes only the term questions, while a seller also reports the gain or loss and, if amending, the earlier year labels.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax (CGT) schedule 2013 (NAT 3423-06.2013), item 7 label A","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=3423-6.2013","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Are you a party to an earnout arrangement?","k":"Earnout arrangement party indicator, CGT schedule item 7 label A (buyer, seller or no)","def":"A short code standing for one of the three boxes on the form. It is a tick-box response transcribed into a code, not a free value.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax (CGT) schedule 2013 (NAT 3423-06.2013), item 7 label A","url":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=3423-6.2013","lim":"The earnout part is on the 2012 schedule and on the 2013 redesign, so the column can carry an answer only for years in which the schedule asked the question, even though it is present in every year table back to 2000-01. Where an entity is party to more than one earnout, the schedule takes one answer and pushes the rest to an attached sheet that is not in this dataset.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CG_EXMPTN_15_YR_FR_SB_AMT","d":"Capital gains wiped out entirely by the small business 15-year exemption, the most generous of the four small business concessions.","full":"Capital gains wiped out entirely by the small business 15-year exemption, the most generous of the four small business concessions. The ATO states it \"means a capital gain is totally disregarded if you or your small business entity has continuously owned the CGT asset for at least 15 years\", and either the owner is 55 or over and retiring or is permanently incapacitated. The amount is quarantined at item 8 and appears nowhere else on the schedule: \"Capital gains to which the small business 15-year exemption applies are only included at item 8 - label A of the CGT schedule.\"","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label A","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business 15 year exemption - exempt capital gains","k":"Small business 15-year exemption, exempt capital gains, CGT schedule item 8 label A (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gain disregarded in full, reported before the CGT discount and excluded from total current year capital gains and from the net capital gain.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label A","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"Because the gain never enters the totals, a retirement sale can leave total current year capital gains looking small while a large disposal took place, and reconciling the two needs this column added back. The eligibility conditions are self-assessed, so the figure records a claim rather than a settled entitlement.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CG_EXMPTN_15_YR_FR_SB_CD","d":"A single letter saying what kind of asset produced the gain that the small business 15-year exemption wiped out.","full":"A single letter saying what kind of asset produced the gain that the small business 15-year exemption wiped out. The ATO publishes the closed set as \"S shares, U units in unit trusts, R real estate, G goodwill, O other CGT assets or CGT events not listed above\", and where several assets were involved the lodger picks the one that produced the largest gain. It qualifies the exempt amount in the column beside it and is the only asset detail the schedule records about that gain.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label A code box","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Small business 15 year exemption - exempt capital gains - code","k":"CGT asset or CGT event code for the 15-year exemption (S, U, R, G, O)","def":"A one-character code drawn from a closed five-value list, entered in the code box beside item 8 label A. It is a letter, not a number, despite the amount label it sits with.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label A code box","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"The code describes only the single largest gain in a year that may have covered several assets, so it undercounts the asset types involved in a business exit. The registry's inferred domain for this column reads it as a calendar year, which the code list contradicts.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CG_FRM_TRST_INCL_MNGD_TRST_AMT","d":"Capital gains the entity received as a distribution from a trust or managed fund, rather than from selling anything itself.","full":"Capital gains the entity received as a distribution from a trust or managed fund, rather than from selling anything itself. The figure is usually larger than the cash distributed, because the ATO requires it to be grossed up: \"If the trustee used the discount method to calculate a capital gain, you need to gross it up by multiplying the distribution amount by 2\", and by four where both the discount and the small business active asset reduction were applied by the trustee. Gains involving a collectable are excluded and go to the collectables row instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label G","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains - Amount of capital gains from a trust (including a managed fund)","k":"Capital gains distributed from a trust, CGT schedule item 1 label G (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of grossed-up capital gain attributed through a trust, entered under the same calculation method the trustee used. It is one of the nine rows that add to label J, and it has no paired loss label because a trust cannot distribute a capital loss.","p":"2012-2013 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label G","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"Reading it as money received overstates the distribution by a factor of two or four. It also cannot be split by the underlying asset the trust sold, so a property gain distributed by a fund is indistinguishable from a share gain.","where":["pmp-cgt-2012-13 / cgt_2012_13_part2","pmp-cgt-2013-14 / cgt_2013_14","pmp-cgt-2014-15 / cgt_2014_15","pmp-cgt-2015-16 / cgt_2015_16","pmp-cgt-2016-17 / cgt_2016_17","pmp-cgt-2017-18 / cgt_2017_18","pmp-cgt-2018-19 / cgt_2018_19","pmp-cgt-2019-20 / cgt_2019_20","pmp-cgt-2020-21 / cgt_2020_21","pmp-cgt-2021-22 / cgt_2021_22","pmp-cgt-2022-23 / cgt_2022_23"]},{"n":"CG_NET_AMT","d":"The one figure on the schedule that reaches the tax return as assessable income.","full":"The one figure on the schedule that reaches the tax return as assessable income. The ATO defines it as \"the amount remaining after applying any: current year capital losses, net capital losses from prior income years, net capital losses transferred in, the CGT discount, any applicable small business CGT concessions\", and the form computes it as item 1 label J less 2E less 4A less 5D. It cannot be negative: an entity worse off than nil reports zero here and carries the loss forward at item 3 instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 6 label A","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net capital gain","k":"Net capital gain, CGT schedule item 6 label A (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount, floored at zero, transferred to label A Net capital gain in the entity's income tax return. It is the schedule's bottom line and the only value on it that is taxed.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 6 label A","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"A zero is ambiguous: it can mean no gains, gains fully absorbed by losses, or gains fully sheltered by concessions, and only the columns above it tell those apart. It also understates economic gain by design, since the discount and the concessions have already been taken off.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CG_OR_LSS_ERNT_ARNGMT_AMDD_AMT","d":"A corrected figure for an earlier year, lodged through this year's schedule because a look-through earnout payment changed what that year's gain should have been.","full":"A corrected figure for an earlier year, lodged through this year's schedule because a look-through earnout payment changed what that year's gain should have been. The ATO instructs the lodger to \"write at label G the amended net capital gain or capital losses carried forward amount resulting from the financial benefits received or provided\", with the earlier year itself named at label F. The route exists only for look-through earnout rights created on or after 24 April 2015, which is why the column starts in the 2015-16 table.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 7 label G","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Amended net capital gain or capital loss carried forward","k":"Amended net capital gain or carried-forward loss, CGT schedule item 7 label G (dollars, signed)","def":"A dollar amount that replaces the earlier year's net capital gain, or its carried-forward loss where the L indicator is printed. It is a restatement of a past year, not a current year quantity.","p":"2015-2016 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 7 label G","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"The amount belongs to the year at label F, not to the year of the row it sits in, so treating it as current year activity misdates it. Access is also conditional: it is available only to individuals and to companies not acting as trustee, lodging on time and amending a single year, so most earnout corrections never appear here at all.","where":["pmp-cgt-2015-16 / cgt_2015_16","pmp-cgt-2016-17 / cgt_2016_17","pmp-cgt-2017-18 / cgt_2017_18","pmp-cgt-2018-19 / cgt_2018_19","pmp-cgt-2019-20 / cgt_2019_20","pmp-cgt-2020-21 / cgt_2020_21","pmp-cgt-2021-22 / cgt_2021_22","pmp-cgt-2022-23 / cgt_2022_23"]},{"n":"CG_OTHR_RL_ESTE_AMT","d":"Capital gains on real estate that is not situated in Australia, the residual half of the pair created when the real estate row was split for 2012-13.","full":"Capital gains on real estate that is not situated in Australia, the residual half of the pair created when the real estate row was split for 2012-13. A non-zero value marks an entity holding property offshore, which is rare enough that the column is mostly empty. The amount is gross of losses, discount and concessions.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label F","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains - Other Real Estate","k":"Capital gains on real estate outside Australia, CGT schedule item 1 label F (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gross capital gain on real property outside Australia, expressed in Australian dollars. It is the sixth gain row at item 1, and label P is its loss counterpart.","p":"2012-2013 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label F","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"The row names no country, so it cannot support any geography beyond 'not Australia'. Read against label A on the same row it separates traded holdings from closely held ones, which is the split that matters for a business exit. The amount is gross of losses, the CGT discount and the small business concessions.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label B","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains - Other shares","k":"Capital gains on unlisted shares, CGT schedule item 1 label B (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gross capital gain for one asset class, summed across the three calculation methods. Nothing on the row identifies the company, so a gain here cannot be tied to the entity that was sold, and shares that qualified for the small business 15-year exemption are excluded from item 1 altogether.","where":["pmp-cgt-2012-13 / cgt_2012_13_part2","pmp-cgt-2013-14 / cgt_2013_14","pmp-cgt-2014-15 / cgt_2014_15","pmp-cgt-2015-16 / cgt_2015_16","pmp-cgt-2016-17 / cgt_2016_17","pmp-cgt-2017-18 / cgt_2017_18","pmp-cgt-2018-19 / cgt_2018_19","pmp-cgt-2019-20 / cgt_2019_20","pmp-cgt-2020-21 / cgt_2020_21","pmp-cgt-2021-22 / cgt_2021_22","pmp-cgt-2022-23 / cgt_2022_23"]},{"n":"CG_OTHR_UNTS_AMT","d":"Capital gains on units in unit trusts that are not listed on an Australian securities exchange, typically unlisted managed funds and private unit trusts.","full":"Capital gains on units in unit trusts that are not listed on an Australian securities exchange, typically unlisted managed funds and private unit trusts. The gain arises when the units are redeemed or sold, so this is a disposal figure and not the trust's own realised gains passed through. Label G on the same row carries the distributed gain instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label D","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains - Other units","k":"Capital gains on unlisted trust units, CGT schedule item 1 label D (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gross capital gain on unlisted units, reported without any split by calculation method. The ATO explains the label as one that \"recognises the previously deferred capital gain in an income year in which a realisation event occurs\", and it exists only because funds were allowed to reset asset cost bases before the superannuation transfer balance cap took effect. The label first appears for 2017-18, and it is one of the few things that force a fund to lodge a CGT schedule regardless of the usual dollar threshold.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label S","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains previously deferred","k":"Capital gain previously deferred under transitional CGT relief, CGT schedule item 1 label S (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gain deferred in an earlier year and recognised now, entered in the item 1 gains column alongside the asset-type rows.","p":"2017-2018, 2020-2021, 2021-2022, 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label S","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"The gain belongs economically to holdings built up over years before 2016-17, so treating it as a gain made in the reporting year overstates that year's activity. The amount is gross of losses, the CGT discount and the small business concessions.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label E","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains - Real Estate situated in Australia","k":"Capital gains on Australian real estate, CGT schedule item 1 label E (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gross capital gain on Australian real property, taken before losses, the CGT discount and the small business concessions. It is the third leg of the three-way asset split that runs the full 2000-01 to 2022-23 span.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax (CGT) schedule 2012 (NAT 3423-6.2012), Part A; and Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025, item 1","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=3423-6.2012","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total capital gains from other CGT assets and any other CGT events","k":"Capital gains from other CGT assets and events, harmonised across CGT schedule editions (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gross capital gain for the residual asset class, before losses, the CGT discount and the small business concessions.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax (CGT) schedule 2012 (NAT 3423-6.2012), Part A; and Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025, item 1","url":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=3423-6.2012","lim":"Its composition is set by what the other rows exclude, so it is not a stable category over 23 years; the forestry managed investment scheme and hedging financial arrangement rows of the pre-2013 schedule carved amounts out of it, and the 2013 redesign dropped both rows. It matches the single \"Shares and units (in unit trusts)\" row that the CGT schedule used up to 2011-12, and from 2012-13 it covers what the redesigned form splits across labels A to D. Because it is populated in every year table it is the shares series that survives the form change, where the four finer labels start only in 2012-13.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax (CGT) schedule 2012 (NAT 3423-6.2012), Part A; and Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025, item 1","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=3423-6.2012","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total capital gains from shares and units (in unit trusts)","k":"Capital gains from shares and units, harmonised across CGT schedule editions (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gross capital gain on equity-type assets, before losses, the CGT discount and the small business concessions.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax (CGT) schedule 2012 (NAT 3423-6.2012), Part A; and Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025, item 1","url":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=3423-6.2012","lim":"Listed and unlisted holdings are not separable in it, so it cannot distinguish a portfolio disposal from the sale of a private company. That a gain distributed by a trust is excluded from this row, and reported separately, is a reading of the schedule structure rather than a published mapping for this column.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CGDSRGRDRSLTFRSCRPRLLOVRAMT","d":"Capital gains put aside because the entity took shares or units in the acquirer instead of cash in a takeover or merger.","full":"Capital gains put aside because the entity took shares or units in the acquirer instead of cash in a takeover or merger. The ATO describes the exchange as one where \"Original interests are shares, units or other interests (or an option, right or similar interest in a company or trust), while replacement interests are the same type of interests in another company or trust.\" The tax is deferred rather than forgiven: the replacement interests carry the original cost base and the gain surfaces when they are sold.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label C","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains disregarded as a result of a scrip for scrip rollover","k":"Capital gains disregarded under scrip for scrip roll-over, CGT schedule item 8 label C (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gain deferred by a roll-over choice, disclosed at item 8 and excluded from the net capital gain at item 6.","p":"2012-2013 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label C","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"Treating the amount as revenue given up double counts, because the same gain is taxed later when the replacement interests are disposed of, and nothing in this dataset links the two events. A takeover part paid in cash gives partial roll-over only, so the figure is not the whole gain on the holding.","where":["pmp-cgt-2012-13 / cgt_2012_13_part2","pmp-cgt-2013-14 / cgt_2013_14","pmp-cgt-2014-15 / cgt_2014_15","pmp-cgt-2015-16 / cgt_2015_16","pmp-cgt-2016-17 / cgt_2016_17","pmp-cgt-2017-18 / cgt_2017_18","pmp-cgt-2018-19 / cgt_2018_19","pmp-cgt-2019-20 / cgt_2019_20","pmp-cgt-2020-21 / cgt_2020_21","pmp-cgt-2021-22 / cgt_2021_22","pmp-cgt-2022-23 / cgt_2022_23"]},{"n":"CGDSRGRDRSLTINTRCOYTRLLOVRAMT","d":"Capital gains disregarded when an asset moved between two companies in the same wholly owned group, at least one of them a foreign resident.","full":"Capital gains disregarded when an asset moved between two companies in the same wholly owned group, at least one of them a foreign resident. The ATO sets the conditions as a transfer where \"a company transfers or creates a CGT asset in another company that is a member of the same wholly-owned group\" and \"at least one of the companies is a foreign resident\". It records an internal restructure rather than a sale to anyone outside the group.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label D","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains disregarded as a result of an inter-company asset rollover","k":"Capital gains disregarded under the inter-company asset roll-over, CGT schedule item 8 label D (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gain disregarded on a same-asset roll-over between group companies, disclosed at item 8 and excluded from the net capital gain at item 6.","p":"2012-2013 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 8 label D","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"The row is a poor measure of group restructuring overall, because transfers within an Australian consolidated group are ignored for tax and never generate an entry at all. It also does not identify the other company, so the direction of the transfer cannot be traced.","where":["pmp-cgt-2012-13 / cgt_2012_13_part2","pmp-cgt-2013-14 / cgt_2013_14","pmp-cgt-2014-15 / cgt_2014_15","pmp-cgt-2015-16 / cgt_2015_16","pmp-cgt-2016-17 / cgt_2016_17","pmp-cgt-2017-18 / cgt_2017_18","pmp-cgt-2018-19 / cgt_2018_19","pmp-cgt-2019-20 / cgt_2019_20","pmp-cgt-2020-21 / cgt_2020_21","pmp-cgt-2021-22 / cgt_2021_22","pmp-cgt-2022-23 / cgt_2022_23"]},{"n":"CGERNTARNGCPTLGAINLSSTHSYRAMT","d":"The gain or the loss the entity made this year under an earnout deal, reported by the seller.","full":"The gain or the loss the entity made this year under an earnout deal, reported by the seller. Sign is carried by a flag rather than a minus: \"If this amount is a loss, print L in the box at the right of the amount at label E.\" A buyer never completes it: the instructions send a buyer to the term questions only, and reserve this label for a seller.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 7 label E","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Amount of any capital gain or loss you made under your earnout arrangement in the income year.","k":"Capital gain or loss under an earnout arrangement, CGT schedule item 7 label E (dollars, signed)","def":"A dollar amount that may be either a gain or a loss, with the direction held in a separate loss indicator on the form rather than in the number itself.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 7 label E","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"Reading the column as a gain without the loss flag reverses the sign for some rows, and this dataset carries the amount without an obvious companion flag column. A loss under a look-through earnout may also have to be temporarily disregarded until future benefits are settled, so a zero can mean a deferred loss rather than no loss.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CGERNTARNGMNTSYRSRUNFRNUM","d":"How long the earnout deal runs in total, in years.","full":"How long the earnout deal runs in total, in years. The ATO instruction is direct: \"Write at label B the number of years the earnout arrangement runs for in total\", and the worked example pairs a 4 at this label with a 2 at label C for someone in the second year of a four year arrangement. It is a term, so it repeats unchanged on each year's schedule for the life of the deal.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 7 label B","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"How many years does the earnout arrangement run for?","k":"Length of the earnout arrangement in years, CGT schedule item 7 label B","def":"A small whole number of years, with no dollar amount attached. It describes the contract, not any gain.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 7 label B","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"The column cannot be summed or averaged across years for one arrangement without counting the same contract repeatedly. It can also only carry an answer for years in which the schedule asked the question: the earnout part is on the 2012 and later schedules, while the column exists in every year table.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CGSHRSINCMPNSASXAMT","d":"Capital gains the lodging entity made in the year on shares in companies listed on an Australian securities exchange.","full":"Capital gains the lodging entity made in the year on shares in companies listed on an Australian securities exchange. It is the first of the nine asset-type rows the redesigned CGT schedule introduced for 2012-13, and it is entered gross: the ATO tells the lodger not to apply \"capital losses\", \"the CGT discount\" or \"the small business CGT concessions\" at this point. The matching loss row for the same asset class is label K.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label A","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains - Shares in companies listed on an Australian securities exchange","k":"Capital gains on listed shares, CGT schedule item 1 label A (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gross capital gain for one asset class, summed across the indexation, discount and other methods. Listing status is the taxpayer's own classification of the asset at disposal, and no equivalent row exists before 2012-13, so a listed-share series cannot start earlier.","where":["pmp-cgt-2012-13 / cgt_2012_13_part2","pmp-cgt-2013-14 / cgt_2013_14","pmp-cgt-2014-15 / cgt_2014_15","pmp-cgt-2015-16 / cgt_2015_16","pmp-cgt-2016-17 / cgt_2016_17","pmp-cgt-2017-18 / cgt_2017_18","pmp-cgt-2018-19 / cgt_2018_19","pmp-cgt-2019-20 / cgt_2019_20","pmp-cgt-2020-21 / cgt_2020_21","pmp-cgt-2021-22 / cgt_2021_22","pmp-cgt-2022-23 / cgt_2022_23"]},{"n":"CGT_OTHR_ASTS_AND_EVNTS_AMT","d":"The residual capital gains row: everything that is not shares, units, real estate, a trust distribution or a collectable.","full":"The residual capital gains row: everything that is not shares, units, real estate, a trust distribution or a collectable. Goodwill on a business sale, contractual rights, crypto assets, leases and the CGT events that do not involve disposing of anything at all are all reported here. Attribution managed investment trusts also use it for gains on transfers of assets between classes.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label I","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains - Other CGT assets and any other CGT events","k":"Capital gains on other CGT assets and events, CGT schedule item 1 label I (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gross capital gain for the residual class, summed across the three calculation methods. It is the last of the nine rows that add to label J, and label R is its loss counterpart.","p":"2012-2013 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label I","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"The category is defined by exclusion, so its composition changes as assets move into named rows and cannot be assumed constant across years. The rate depends on who is lodging: the ATO gives it as \"33⅓% for complying superannuation entities\" and \"50% for individuals and trusts\", and adds that \"Companies can't claim the CGT discount unless they are life insurance companies or friendly societies that carry on life insurance business.\" A non-zero value therefore all but rules out an ordinary company lodger.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 4 label A","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total CGT discount applied","k":"Total CGT discount applied, CGT schedule item 4 label A (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of reduction, not a gain. It is subtracted at item 6 along with the small business concessions, and on the schedules to 2011-12 it was reported separately for active and non-active assets.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 4 label A","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"Dividing it by the gross gain does not recover the discount rate, because losses are applied first and only long-held gains qualify. It also cannot show what an entity was entitled to but did not use, since gains with no discount available simply produce a zero.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CGUTLISTDINASXAMT","d":"Capital gains on units in unit trusts listed on an Australian securities exchange, including listed property trusts and exchange traded funds.","full":"Capital gains on units in unit trusts listed on an Australian securities exchange, including listed property trusts and exchange traded funds. It records the disposal of the units themselves, not a distribution received from the trust; a distributed gain belongs at label G. The amount is gross of losses, discount and concessions.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label C","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital gains - Units in unit trusts listed on an Australian securities exchange","k":"Capital gains on listed trust units, CGT schedule item 1 label C (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gross capital gain on listed units, entered before losses and the CGT discount. The ATO builds it by addition: \"Add up the amounts at item 2 - labels B, C and D and write the total at label E Total capital losses applied\", which is current year losses, prior year net losses and losses transferred in. It is the amount subtracted at the net capital gain step, so it is the loss figure that actually changed the tax.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 2 label E","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Current year capital losses applied","k":"Total capital losses applied, CGT schedule item 2 label E (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of loss used, entered as a positive number and subtracted at item 6 before the discount and the concessions. The custodian's wording for this column in the 2000-01 to 2012-13 tables reads 'Current year capital losses applied', which is the description of label B rather than of this total, so the two columns cannot be told apart on the label text alone.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CL_CF_LTR_INCM_YRS_NET_AMT","d":"The bank of capital losses the entity takes into next year, excluding collectables.","full":"The bank of capital losses the entity takes into next year, excluding collectables. It is the running balance that survives after this year's gains have absorbed what they could, and the ATO adds it to the collectables balance at item 3 label A to give label V on the tax return. Unlike the applied columns, this is a stock rather than a flow.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 3 label B","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Other net capital losses carried forward to later income years","k":"Unapplied net capital losses carried forward, CGT schedule item 3 label B (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of loss not yet used, carried indefinitely. The figure also has no vintage attached, so the age profile of the bank cannot be recovered.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 12 more"]},{"n":"CL_CLTBLS_AMT","d":"Capital losses on collectables such as art, jewellery, antiques and coins, kept in a row of their own because they are ring-fenced.","full":"Capital losses on collectables such as art, jewellery, antiques and coins, kept in a row of their own because they are ring-fenced. The ATO puts the fence plainly: \"If you have capital losses from collectables, you can only apply those to your capital gains from collectables.\" Anything not absorbed by a collectables gain is carried forward separately and reappears at item 3 label A, and on a superannuation fund return the row marks a fund holding art or memorabilia.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label Q","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital loss - Collectables","k":"Capital losses on collectables, CGT schedule item 1 label Q (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of capital loss on collectables, calculated as capital proceeds less the reduced cost base. Collectables acquired for $500 or less are disregarded entirely and never reach the row, so small holdings are invisible rather than zero.","where":["pmp-cgt-2012-13 / cgt_2012_13_part2","pmp-cgt-2013-14 / cgt_2013_14","pmp-cgt-2014-15 / cgt_2014_15","pmp-cgt-2015-16 / cgt_2015_16","pmp-cgt-2016-17 / cgt_2016_17","pmp-cgt-2017-18 / cgt_2017_18","pmp-cgt-2018-19 / cgt_2018_19","pmp-cgt-2019-20 / cgt_2019_20","pmp-cgt-2020-21 / cgt_2020_21","pmp-cgt-2021-22 / cgt_2021_22","pmp-cgt-2022-23 / cgt_2022_23"]},{"n":"CL_CY_APLD_AMT","d":"How much of this year's capital losses was actually deducted from this year's capital gains.","full":"How much of this year's capital losses was actually deducted from this year's capital gains. Applying them is not optional where gains exist: \"If your entity has current year capital losses that can be deducted, you must deduct them here. You can't choose to defer to a later income year any amount that you can deduct\". The gap between this figure and total current year capital losses is what gets carried forward.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 2 label B","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Current year capital losses applied","k":"Current year capital losses applied, CGT schedule item 2 label B (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of loss used in the year, deducted before prior year losses and before the CGT discount. It is losses made, not losses used: what was actually deducted from gains is the applied figure further down item 2, and any surplus is carried forward at item 3. The ATO builds it by addition: \"Add up the amounts at item 1 - labels K to R and write the total at item 2 - label A Total current year capital losses.\" On the schedules to 2011-12 the same total sat at Part B label D, in a part the form headed as covering capital losses other than losses from collectables.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 2 label A","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total current year capital losses","k":"Total current year capital losses, CGT schedule item 2 label A (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount summing the loss rows for the year, entered as a positive number. The ATO defines the pool as \"the unapplied net capital losses carried forward from earlier income years\", and they must be deducted in the order they were made, oldest first, after current year losses have been used. For a company the deduction also depends on passing the continuity of ownership or the same or similar business test.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 2 label C","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Prior year net capital losses applied","k":"Prior year net capital losses applied, CGT schedule item 2 label C (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of carried-forward loss used this year, net of any adjustment for commercial debts forgiven. One class is expressly kept out of it, since the ATO directs the lodger not to \"include any capital loss made from personal use assets at Other CGT assets and any other CGT events\" because those losses are disregarded. It was Part B label C on the schedules to 2011-12 and label R from 2012-13.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label R","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital loss - Other CGT assets and any other CGT events","k":"Capital losses on other CGT assets and events, CGT schedule item 1 label R (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of capital loss for the residual asset class, calculated as capital proceeds less the reduced cost base. Amounts are converted to Australian dollars at the relevant exchange rates, so movement in the currency alone can turn a foreign gain into an Australian dollar loss. The row is sparsely used.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label P","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital loss - Other Real Estate","k":"Capital losses on real estate outside Australia, CGT schedule item 1 label P (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of capital loss on foreign real property, expressed in Australian dollars and calculated as capital proceeds less the reduced cost base. Losses on shares in a company that is wound up or deregistered are commonly reported here, so the row is a rough marker of investments written off. It counts losses made in the year, not the part of them applied against gains.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label L","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital loss - Other shares","k":"Capital losses on unlisted shares, CGT schedule item 1 label L (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of capital loss for one asset class, calculated as capital proceeds less the reduced cost base. The loss is realised on redemption or sale of the units, which for an unlisted fund can lag the underlying fall in value by a long time. It is the loss column beside label D.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label N","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital loss - Other units","k":"Capital losses on unlisted trust units, CGT schedule item 1 label N (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of capital loss on unlisted units, calculated without any indexation of the reduced cost base. Capital works and depreciation deductions claimed while the property was held reduce its cost base, so a property sold for close to its purchase price can still be reported here as a gain rather than a loss. A loss on real estate is uncommon and the column is mostly empty.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label O","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital loss - Real Estate situated in Australia","k":"Capital losses on Australian real estate, CGT schedule item 1 label O (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of capital loss on Australian real property, calculated as capital proceeds less the reduced cost base, which cannot be indexed. The reduced cost base subtracts deductions already claimed, so the tax loss and the economic loss on the same sale differ, sometimes in sign.","where":["pmp-cgt-2012-13 / cgt_2012_13_part2","pmp-cgt-2013-14 / cgt_2013_14","pmp-cgt-2014-15 / cgt_2014_15","pmp-cgt-2015-16 / cgt_2015_16","pmp-cgt-2016-17 / cgt_2016_17","pmp-cgt-2017-18 / cgt_2017_18","pmp-cgt-2018-19 / cgt_2018_19","pmp-cgt-2019-20 / cgt_2019_20","pmp-cgt-2020-21 / cgt_2020_21","pmp-cgt-2021-22 / cgt_2021_22","pmp-cgt-2022-23 / cgt_2022_23"]},{"n":"CL_TFRD_IN_APLD_AMT","d":"Capital losses handed over by another company in the same wholly owned group and used here.","full":"Capital losses handed over by another company in the same wholly owned group and used here. The transfer route is narrow: \"Transfer of net capital losses is only applicable to group companies. All other entities record zeros\", and the current form limits label D to transfers involving a foreign bank branch or the permanent establishment of a foreign financial entity. A non-zero value therefore marks a member of a corporate group rather than a standalone lodger.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 2 label D","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital losses transferred in applied","k":"Net capital losses transferred in applied, CGT schedule item 2 label D (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of loss originating in another company and applied against this entity's gains. The other carried-forward balance sits beside it at label B.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 3 label A","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net capital losses from collectables carried forward to later income year","k":"Collectables net capital losses carried forward, CGT schedule item 3 label A (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of unused collectables loss, tracked separately from all other capital losses and added to the label B balance only for the total shown on the return.","p":"2000-2001 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 3 label A","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","lim":"The balance can sit unused indefinitely, so a large figure signals a stalled loss rather than future tax relief. A loss arises only when the units are sold or redeemed, so a fall in the unit price of a listed property trust that is still held never appears. Tax-deferred distributions received over the holding period reduce the cost base and so enlarge the loss recorded here.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label M","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital loss - Units in unit trusts listed on an Australian securities exchange","k":"Capital losses on listed trust units, CGT schedule item 1 label M (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of capital loss on listed units, entered as a positive number in the capital loss column at item 1. The eight loss rows K to R add to the total at item 2 label A.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax schedule and instructions 2025 (QC 104724), item 1 label K","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0-35964a77-f4ba-4cf3-a068-bb59670617a2","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Capital loss - Shares in companies listed on an Australian securities exchange","k":"Capital losses on listed shares, CGT schedule item 1 label K (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of capital loss, calculated as capital proceeds less the reduced cost base, with no indexation available. Losses are applied before the discount, so where a taxpayer puts them is a choice with a tax consequence: the ATO notes that for most people the order giving the smallest net capital gain is to apply losses against other-method gains first, then indexation, then discount. The first element is the narrowest part of a cost base: the ATO lists the five elements and puts first \"money you paid, or property you gave, for the asset\", with incidental and ownership costs following in the later elements. It fixes the acquirer's tax position on a later sale of the interests it has bought.","dsrc":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax 2025, Appendix 4 Definitions, Cost base","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/guide-to-capital-gains-tax-2025/appendixes/appendix-4-definitions","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"First element of cost base of interests acquired","k":"First element of cost base of interests acquired (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount for the first element only, so it excludes stamp duty, adviser fees and other incidental costs that belong to the second element. Where the target holders took the roll-over the acquirer's cost base can be capped by rules that look through to the target's own cost base, so the figure need not equal what was paid.","where":["pmp-cgt-2000-01 / cgt_2000_01","pmp-cgt-2001-02 / cgt_2001_02","pmp-cgt-2002-03 / cgt_2002_03","pmp-cgt-2003-04 / cgt_2003_04","pmp-cgt-2004-05 / cgt_2004_05","pmp-cgt-2005-06 / cgt_2005_06","pmp-cgt-2006-07 / cgt_2006_07","pmp-cgt-2007-08 / cgt_2007_08","pmp-cgt-2008-09 / cgt_2008_09","pmp-cgt-2009-10 / cgt_2009_10","pmp-cgt-2010-11 / cgt_2010_11","pmp-cgt-2011-12 / cgt_2011_12","and 1 more"]},{"n":"L_SCRPT_ACQ_ENT_JNT_RLOVR_L","d":"Whether the bidder and a significant stakeholder in the target jointly chose the roll-over, a step required in closely held takeovers.","full":"Whether the bidder and a significant stakeholder in the target jointly chose the roll-over, a step required in closely held takeovers. It is a count, not a dollar figure, and it sits in the part of the schedule headed \"Scrip-for-scrip rollover for acquiring entity\", which the form reserves for companies and trusts. The tax file number of the original entity is asked for on the same row, though that identifier is not carried into this dataset.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax (CGT) schedule 2010 (NAT 3423-6.2010), part L label F","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=3423-6.2010","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Number of original entities","k":"Count of original entities in a scrip for scrip roll-over","def":"A whole number of entities acquired, with no dollar units. It is reported separately because those stakeholders are the ones the anti-avoidance rules watch: \"There are special rules if a company or trust has a small number of shareholders or beneficiaries and there is a significant or common stakeholder.\" In such cases the acquirer takes the stakeholder's own cost base rather than market value.","dsrc":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax 2021, Scrip for scrip rollover","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/capital-gains-tax-guide-2021/whats-new/investments-in-shares-and-units/scrip-for-scrip-rollover","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Cost base - significant common stakeholder interests acquired","k":"Cost base of significant common stakeholder interests acquired (dollars)","def":"A dollar cost base for one class of acquired interests, separate from the first element figure reported for the rest. It is the acquirer's record of the consideration that breaks the roll-over for the target holders, since \"the rollover applies only to the replacement interest\". Read with the number of original entities on the same row, it shows the cash component of the year's acquisitions.","dsrc":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax 2021, Scrip for scrip rollover","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/capital-gains-tax-guide-2021/whats-new/investments-in-shares-and-units/scrip-for-scrip-rollover","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Amount of other considerations","k":"Other considerations given by an acquiring entity (dollars)","def":"A dollar total of non-scrip consideration given, reported by the acquiring company or trust. The custodian's description, \"To be completed by companies only\", is the form's completion note rather than the question, which reads \"Did you have an employee share scheme in place at any time during the year?\" It is a standing yes or no about the company, not a CGT amount, and it sits in the schedule because share scheme interests generate CGT events for the employees who hold them.","dsrc":"ATO, Capital gains tax (CGT) schedule 2010 (NAT 3423-6.2010), part M label N","durl":"https://iorder.com.au/publication/Download.aspx?ProdID=3423-6.2010","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"To be completed by companies only","k":"Employee share scheme in place indicator, companies only (yes or no)","def":"A yes or no indicator with no dollar value. Collectables are a separate class in the ATO's records - \"those relating to collectables (for example, jewellery)\" - and they are separate because their losses are ring-fenced: \"You can only use capital losses from collectables to reduce capital gains from collectables.\" They sit under non-active assets because they cannot qualify for the small business concessions.","dsrc":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax","durl":"https://caat-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/62327127-22dc-4be1-8fbe-031cb313496a_7bbe17ea_9cd6_4c09_8d67_211d38ed98e8_pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-active assets - Collectables: Capital gains - discount method","k":"Collectables capital gains, discount method (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount of gain on collectables, before the discount percentage is applied.","p":"2000-2001 to 2012-2013","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Guide to capital gains tax","url":"https://caat-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/62327127-22dc-4be1-8fbe-031cb313496a_7bbe17ea_9cd6_4c09_8d67_211d38ed98e8_pdf","lim":"The ring-fencing means a loss on collectables cannot reduce any other gain, so a taxpayer with collectables losses and other gains still pays tax on the gains. The ATO lists the class as \"artwork\", \"jewellery\", \"antiques\", \"coins or medallions\", \"rare folios, manuscripts or books\" and \"postage stamps or first day covers\", and exempts an item entirely where \"you acquired the collectable for $500 or less\". Collectables get their own row because their losses are quarantined from every other gain on the schedule.","dsrc":"ATO, List of CGT assets and exemptions, Collectables","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/investments-and-assets/capital-gains-tax/list-of-cgt-assets-and-exemptions","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-active assets - Collectables: Capital gains - indexation method","k":"Collectables capital gains, indexation method, non-active assets (dollars)","def":"A dollar amount for the income year, gross of capital losses and the small business concessions, measured against an indexed cost base.
